svg.title: Proposition 6.1 (Continuum validation of a phase-grid reader). Let ρ±(θ) be the pure states of Uz(θ)(a|0⟩± b|1⟩), where a, b ≥0, a2 + b2 = 1, s = a2 −b2, and Uz is a rotation by angle θ about the Bloch z axis. Let a fixed reader and bounded nonnegative decision loss give operators 0 ≤C± ≤CmaxI and risk R(M, θ) = 1 2 Tr[C+(M)ρ+(θ)] + 1 2 Tr[C−(M)ρ−(θ)].
